pageProps.content: ## Review After studying at a nearby cafe for a bit, I looked for a restaurant nearby to have dinner. Maybe because the weather had been hot for a few days, I didn't particularly feel like eating anything. After debating for a long time, I decided to go for `Dakgalbi` as a safe choice, so I looked for a nearby Dakgalbi restaurant. I didn't know it, but apparently it is a famous franchise. When I looked it up, the head store seemed to be in Uijeongbu. I ordered 2 servings of the most standard Dakgalbi and added ramen noodles. I debated for a while between the traditional udon noodles and ramen, but ended up choosing ramen noodles. ```adcard ``` I thought about ordering a Makguksu too, but decided to make up my mind after eating first. After waiting a little, the Dakgalbi came out fully cooked. There were reviews saying the portion was large, and indeed, it was a lot. As I get older, I can't eat as much as before, but even considering that, the portion was not small. ```adcard ``` The taste was just typical Dakgalbi. It wasn't exceptionally delicious or bad; it was just a decent, average taste. By the time I finished eating, I was so full that I couldn't even make fried rice, and in the end, I couldn't eat Makguksu either. ## Pictures
